# Demo module: Calculus in R

This is a demo `{box}`-`{carrier}` module that uses native compiled codes which contains functions involving calculus. 

## Requirements

-  `{carrier}` binary (see [installation](https://joshuamarie.com/carrier/installation.html) for details)
-  Rtools toolchain 
-  `{box}` R package (see [installation](https://joshuamarie.com/carrier/installation.html) for more details)

## Installation

``` bash
carrier install gh:joshuamarie/carrier/tree/main/examples/modules/rcalc --install-deps
```

```{r}
box::use(rcalc)
```

## Examples

Here's an example that finds the root of a function using Brent's method:

```{r}
rcalc$brentq(\(x) x^2 - 4, 0, 5)
```
